svg.title: CLOTHO WebMCP human loop
svg.desc: A cinematic process map from person request through agent tool call, visible proposal, human choice, explicit write, and local calendar state.
svg.text: The agent coordinates the work. The person owns the decision.
PROPOSAL TOOLS CAN RETURN OPTIONS. WRITE TOOLS CHANGE STATE ONLY AFTER A VISIBLE PRODUCT ACTION.
That boundary is the product: agent speed without silent takeover.
14 REAL WEBMCP TOOLS · ONE REVIEWABLE LOOP
